title: Venezuela Says Oil Supply Negotiations With US Progressing
description: Venezuela's state-run oil company PDVSA said on Wednesday it is progressing in negotiations with the United States for oil sales, as a board member for the company told Reuters the US will need to buy cargoes at international prices.

title: Trump says US to get 30-50 million barrels of oil from Venezuela at market price
description: CARACAS (Venezuela), Jan 7: President Donald Trump has said on his social media site that “Interim Authorities” in Venezuela would be providing 30 million to 50 million barrels of “High Quality” oil to the US at its market price. title: U.S. Vice President Vance Stresses Control Over Venezuelan Oil Interests
description: U.S. Vice President JD Vance indicated that Venezuela is allowed to sell its oil only if it aligns with U.S. national interests. He stated this control during an interview, highlighting the United States' authority over Venezuela's energy resources following recent military actions against the country.
